Tried 2 times and got screwed both times. I will never go back.
Dec 2025 • Solo
My first visit two months ago should have been my last. After spending four hours at this bar with my girlfriend, I discovered they had overcharged us for eight drinks we never ordered. When I brought this to their attention, they flat-out refused to correct the bill. I left frustrated but decided to give them another chance.

Tonight proved that was a mistake. After being seated and receiving my first drink, I was completely ignored. For 30 solid minutes, I sat at the bar unable to get anyone’s attention. I watched staff greet and serve every new customer who walked in while I couldn’t even flag down a server for a second drink. It was as if I didn’t exist.

When I finally got the manager’s attention and explained what happened, she called me a liar to my face. Only after reviewing their own security footage - which confirmed everything I said - did she see I was telling the truth. Instead of apologizing, she simply walked away without a word.

This establishment has serious problems with both billing integrity and basic customer service. The management’s response when confronted with legitimate issues is dismissive at best, hostile at worst. I’ve given them two chances and been burned both times. Save yourself the frustration and money - there are plenty of better bars that actually value their customers.

Entertaining Expat Bar
Apr 2023 • Solo
Number 5 Bar is owned by a European gentleman, and it shows in the dinner menu. The food here is EXCELLENT. This is a hostess bar with a pool table and darts. The ladies are fun and like to keep the guests entertained. The bar is well stocked. The hostesses share bartending duties; ask for Hahn to make the best margarita in town. This place draws a large number of expats, which on most nights outnumber the locals. There is live music three or four nights a week. The wine bar next door is the same ownership and management; that section is non-smoking.
